comparison.objective: Pick four arriving parts from two conveyor lanes into a bin before deadlines.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed multi-object interception and direct carrier-to-bin transfer versus lifting and agitating one screen to filter a mixture.
comparison.success_condition: Each cube in bin earns 0.25; staging, missing the deadline, or knocking a cube off loses that cube.
comparison.reason: Generic multi-object transfer is shared, but the tested ability is conveyor scheduling rather than geometry-selective passage.
